title: Acne Scars: Which Treatment Works For Which Scar?
metaTitle: Acne Scars: Which Treatment Works For Which Scar? | Skin Essence Pune
metaDescription: Ice-pick, boxcar and rolling scars need different treatments. A plain guide from a dermatology clinic in Kalyani Nagar, Pune. Read before you book.
excerpt: No single procedure fixes every acne scar. The scar type decides the treatment, which is why mapping comes before lasers, needles or peels.
